newsitem.title: USA: ANNTAYLOR SEES Q2 MEETING LOWER FORECAST.
newsitem.headline: ANNTAYLOR SEES Q2 MEETING LOWER FORECAST.

text.p: AnnTaylor Stores Corp said Thursday it expected its second-quarter earnings to meet First Call's revised estimates for the women's specialty retailer.
AnnTaylor said in a statement its earnings would be "within the range" set by First Call from a consensus among analysts that cover the retailer.
First Call lowered its forecast to a profit of $0.05 per share for the quarter from $0.17.
The figure compares with a profit of $0.03 per share that AnnTaylor reported for the same period last year.
The retailer, which is to release earnings on August 19, also reported a 9.2-percent decline in same-store sales for the four-week period ended August 2.
Walter Parks, the chief financial officer, told Reuters that AnnTaylor had lower sales for the period because it was focusing on driving full-price sales and improving inventory turn.
Parks said it had also reduced promotional activity.
